capabilities: Chat with a local AI agent or a model API provider
Attach vault files, folders, web pages, or images as context
Rewrite a selected passage in the note
Review recorded file changes before accepting them
Send a reply to the daily note or another note
extras: Desktop account sign-in opens the provider website with a temporary loopback callback; local CLI agents and MCP connections are desktop-only. Mobile behavior has not been checked on physical devices. Cloud requests send prompt and attached context to the chosen provider, which may charge for usage; keys are stored in Obsidian SecretStorage. No conversation server or telemetry. Requires Obsidian 1.11.4+.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to ask an AI agent about the current note or vault files while keeping control over which model provider and credentials are used.

requires.name: Local CLI agent or model provider

summary: Sidebar AI agent for chatting with vault notes using local CLI agents or your own model API key, with file attachments and change review.
